content.loadFailed: Failed to load IGMP proxy configuration
content.title: IGMP Proxy
content.subtitle: Proxy multicast traffic between upstream and downstream networks
content.noInterfacesHint: IGMP proxy requires at least one upstream and one downstream interface. Use the setup wizard to configure both at once.

deleteModal.title: Remove Interface
deleteModal.description: Are you sure you want to remove <mono>{name}</mono> from the IGMP proxy configuration? This will remove the interface role, threshold, alt-subnets, and whitelist entries.

interfaceModal.invalidAltSubnet: Invalid alt-subnet format: {value}. Use CIDR notation (e.g., 10.0.0.0/8)
interfaceModal.invalidWhitelist: Invalid whitelist format: {value}. Use CIDR notation (e.g., 239.0.0.0/8)
interfaceModal.editDescription: Modify the IGMP proxy configuration for {name}.
interfaceModal.addDescription: Add a new interface to the IGMP proxy configuration.
interfaceModal.interfaceHelp: Network interface to participate in IGMP proxy.
interfaceModal.roleHelp: Upstream receives multicast from the source network. Downstream forwards multicast to client networks.
interfaceModal.thresholdHelp: Minimum TTL required for multicast packets to be forwarded (1-255).
interfaceModal.altSubnetsHelp: Allow multicast from sources outside the directly connected subnet. Typically used on the upstream interface.
interfaceModal.whitelistHelp: Only proxy multicast traffic for these group address ranges. Leave empty to allow all groups.

setupModal.mustDiffer: Upstream and downstream must be different interfaces
setupModal.upstreamThresholdRange: Upstream threshold must be between 1 and 255
setupModal.downstreamThresholdRange: Downstream threshold must be between 1 and 255
setupModal.invalidUpstreamAltSubnet: Invalid upstream alt-subnet: {value}. Use CIDR notation (e.g., 10.0.0.0/8)
setupModal.description: IGMP proxy requires at least one upstream and one downstream interface. Configure both to get started.
setupModal.upstreamHelp: Receives multicast traffic from the source network.
setupModal.altSubnetsHelp: Allow multicast from sources outside the directly connected subnet.
setupModal.whitelistHelp: Only proxy these multicast group ranges. Leave empty for all.
setupModal.downstreamHelp: Forwards multicast traffic to the client network.
